scope: Tool interface specifications. Execution and backend connections are not implemented here.

tools.implementation_status: To connect to the existing audio pipeline

function.name: analyze_machine_audio
function.description: Analyze a WAV recording of a pump or fan using the audio anomaly detection model. Return the anomaly score, decision threshold and normal or anomalous classification. This tool does not identify a specific mechanical fault and does not save or modify data.

audio_path.description: Path of the WAV file supplied by the user.

machine_id.description: Machine identifier used to select the appropriate model, for example 00.

tools.implementation_status: To connect to the existing RAG pipeline

function.name: search_manuals
function.description: Search pump or fan technical manuals for passages relevant to a maintenance question. Return the retrieved text with document names and page numbers. Report when no relevant passage is found. This tool does not modify documents.

machine_type.description: Machine type used to filter the manuals.

top_k.description: Maximum number of passages to retrieve.

function.name: create_maintenance_ticket
function.description: Create a maintenance ticket linked to an existing audio analysis. Use only after a human has reviewed and explicitly approved the exact ticket content. Return the identifier of the created ticket. Do not claim a confirmed mechanical fault based only on an audio anomaly.

analysis_id.description: Identifier of the existing audio analysis.

description.description: Observed facts and requested checks. Clearly distinguish observations from unconfirmed hypotheses.
